name: Pouch of Endless Rations
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 10; Weight 0.5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This small leather pouch contains enough trail rations and water to feed a single Medium creature for one day.

Every morning at sunrise the pouch magically creates another day’s worth of food and water. Any remaining food and water left unconsumed disappears.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells create food and water
